thread:
maria: Quick thread 90s follow-up on cross-project operator keys. We still have too many long-lived org-level keys and no consistent attestation for cross-project actions.
tom: Agreed. Summary of constraints: least-privilege, backward compat for CI, strong audit trail, and short TTL for destructive ops.
lee: Proposal sketch: default API keys = project-scoped. Allow org-level operator keys only when accompanied by a signed short-lived operator-claim header (X-Operator-Claim). Operator-claim includes actor_id, reason, ttl, ticket_id, and signature.
maria: Important: require a signer service (runbook-service) that mints operator-claims after 2-step approval for humans and explicit CI allowlist for machines.
tom: Migration advice: introduce operator-claim acceptance points, then surface telemetry for org-keys, then ban organ-keys on write/delete after 180 days.
lee: Gateway enforcement pseudo: ```
if not key.is_project_scoped and route.is_sensitive:
  if not header.contains('X-Operator-Claim') or not verify_sig(header.X-Operator-Claim):
    reject(403)
  else:
    if claim.ttl > 900: reject(400, 'ttl-too-large')
    if not policy.allow(claim.actor, route): reject(403)
```
ops-bot: inventory-bot: scanned 1724500300 -> 178 long-lived org keys found, flagged 23 high-usage keys.
maria: For service mesh: prefer propagating original operator-claim. If proxy must mint, it must use a PKI-issued minting cert and record original caller in the minted claim.
tom: CI concern: allowlist CI service-accounts in infra project, but require rotation and auditing. Exemptions are timeboxed (eg 90 days) and logged.
lee: Security rules: destructive routes (DELETE, OWNER-CHANGE) require claim.ttl <= 900 and claim.reason in allowed-reasons set. Console use by humans must require MFA on key creation and claim issuance.
maria: UX / ops: add clear labels in key creation UI: "project-scoped (recommended)" vs "org-operator (requires extra attestation)" and link to runbook.
tom: I'll make an inventory export and list top 10 services using org keys.
lee: I'll put a draft RFC with migration timeline: opt-in 60d, telemetry-only 120d, enforced 180d.
maria: Thanks all. Filing RFC into #eng-security-rfcs and tagging security oncall.
tom: :thumbsup:
